mapper.insert: insert into recycle_order ( order_no, user_id, collector_id, address_id, address_detail, address_lat, address_lng, building_type, floor, contact_name, contact_phone, appliance_type_id, appliance_type_name, appliance_desc, appliance_imgs,brand_level, usage_years, functional_status, appearance_level, condition_factor, price_estimate, estimated_weight, expect_date, expect_time_start, expect_time_end, urgency_level, assign_type, status, points_earned, create_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{collectorId}, #{addressId}, #{addressDetail}, #{addressLat}, #{addressLng}, #{buildingType}, #{floor}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{applianceTypeId}, #{applianceTypeName}, #{applianceDesc}, #{applianceImgs},#{brandLevel}, #{usageYears}, #{functionalStatus}, #{appearanceLevel}, #{conditionFactor}, #{priceEstimate}, #{estimatedWeight}, #{expectDate}, #{expectTimeStart}, #{expectTimeEnd}, #{urgencyLevel}, #{assignType}, #{status}, #{pointsEarned}, now())
mapper.select: select * from recycle_order where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
select * from recycle_order where collector_id = #{collectorId} order by create_time desc
select * from recycle_order where status = #{status} order by create_time asc
select avg(user_rating) from recycle_order where collector_id = #{collectorId} and user_rating is not null
select count(*) from recycle_order where date(create_time) = curdate()
select count(*) from recycle_order where status = #{status}
select coalesce(sum(weight_actual), 0) from recycle_order where status = 4
select coalesce(sum(carbon_saved), 0) from recycle_order where status = 4
select appliance_type_name as name, count(*) as count, sum(weight_actual) as weight from recycle_order where status = 4 group by appliance_type_id
mapper.update: update recycle_order set status = 1, collector_id = #{collectorId}, assign_type = 3, assign_time = now(), version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{oldVersion} and status = 0
